description: This file contains functions related to loading, decoding, and compressing image attachments within an Android application, specifically for chat image handling. It includes utilities for scaling images, encoding to Base64, managing image cache, and normalizing file names.

methods.name: loadSizedImageAttachment
methods.description: Loads an image from a URI, scales it to a maximum width, compresses to meet size constraints, encodes as Base64, and returns a PendingImageAttachment object.

methods.name: decodeBase64Bitmap
methods.description: Decodes a Base64-encoded string into a Bitmap, utilizing a cache to optimize repeated decode requests.

methods.name: computeInSampleSize
methods.description: Calculates an appropriate sample size for downsampling an image based on maximum dimension constraints.

methods.name: normalizeAttachmentFileName
methods.description: Sanitizes and normalizes a raw filename string, ensuring it is a valid image filename.

methods.name: decodeScaledBitmap
methods.description: Decodes a scaled-down version of an image from a URI, maintaining aspect ratio within the specified maximum dimension.
